sources_read.section: 026's session-wide read to mirror for notes
the shared context that supplies profileId/sessionId

scope: The session-wide notes read, the export hook (row mapping + append + zip + download), the download helper, and the header control. Out of scope: re-import (016's, unchanged); the ink SVG (waits on 024); any bundle-format change.

acceptance_criteria.text: use-notes-for-session returns the notes of the session's highlights and [] when there are none.
The hook maps rows to BundleInput, skips a slug-less highlight, appends annotations (never re-renders), zips and downloads workspace-{slug}-{yyyymmdd}.zip.
downloadBytes creates an object URL, clicks an anchor and revokes the URL.
The header control triggers the export and disables while busy; a missing artifact reports why.

open_questions: D-02 (defaulted: the export is the workspace's main document) — the note-slot copy is not exported; raised, not re-decided.
D-10 (defaulted: the group document is not cached offline) — the bundle reads local rows and the main artifact's bytes (downloaded on demand), so it does not require the note copy offline.

RULE-25 (standing) — the bundle format is 016's; 027 only calls it. The filename slug comes from the session title (a plain slugify); if the product wants a specific workspace slug, that is a later change.
risks: Re-rendering a page on export destroys the text layer (spec §5.6) — appendHighlightsToPdf appends and is untouched.
A highlight with no slug would break the anchor round trip — it is skipped rather than mis-anchored.
Exporting before the bytes are cached triggers a Storage download; an offline first export of an uncached PDF will fail with a message, which is acceptable (the bundle is an online-or-cached action).
A large PDF + many highlights make the zip heavy; the work is user-initiated and shows a busy state.
